name: Too many errors
action: Open Phoenix, find a failed trace and read which step failed; check both providers. Runbook section 3.1.

name: Slow answers
action: Open Phoenix, find the slowest span; is the fallback model in use? Runbook section 3.2.

name: Running on the fallback model
action: The primary model is failing or rate-limiting: check the primary provider's status page. Runbook section 3.3.

name: Spending more than planned
action: Look for a loop or a flood of requests in the dashboard's recent list. Runbook section 3.4.
